templates.builtin.earnBountyHunter.name: Earn bounty hunter
templates.builtin.earnBountyHunter.descr: Scout Superteam Earn, research a pick, build with capped vendor spend.
templates.builtin.earnBountyHunter.summa: Scout and research never pay; only the builder spends on allowlisted vendors.
templates.builtin.earnBountyHunter.howIt:
Scout lists up to three Earn bounties. Research writes a brief for the bounty you approve.

The builder pays RPC, inference, and hosting through Agent Rails — not a hot wallet.

You submit on Earn; agents cannot widen their own limits.
templates.builtin.earnBountyHunter.setup:
Run pnpm agent-rails init for a devnet treasury and policy.
Add labelled destinations for RPC, inference, and hosting.
Create one session per bounty for the Builder.
Download per-agent MCP from Agents → MCP.
Approve which bounty to pursue before research starts.
templates.builtin.dcaSol.name: DCA into SOL
templates.builtin.dcaSol.description: Scheduled USDC slices to an allowlisted swap desk — no model timer.
templates.builtin.dcaSol.summary: Cron + agent-rails pay each period; swaps happen from your desk wallet.
templates.builtin.dcaSol.howItWorks:
A treasury holds USDC. A cron script calls agent-rails pay on a schedule.

Each payment uses a period reference so retries cannot double-pay.

The swap desk is an allowlisted owner you control; Agent Rails does not swap on-chain.
templates.builtin.dcaSol.setupSteps:
Init treasury with token limits for your DCA size.
Allowlist the swap desk wallet.
Copy examples/templates/dca-sol/dca.env.example.
Install the cron entry from the template README.
Use guardian-watch / alert-watch for denials.
templates.builtin.defiYieldRebalance.des: Scout rates, plan a capped move, executor pays venue desks only.
templates.builtin.defiYieldRebalance.sum: Planner reads policy; executor spends up to cap on allowlisted desks.
templates.builtin.defiYieldRebalance.how:
Scout gathers rates. Planner proposes a rebalance within policy headroom.

Executor pays USDC to labelled desk wallets — not protocol vaults.

Deposits into protocols are a separate human- or desk-signed step.
templates.builtin.defiYieldRebalance.set:
Init treasury and set conservative USDC limits.
Allowlist one desk wallet per venue.
Create sessions: planner readonly, executor full.
Run scout-rates.sh or your feed; use a proposal id in payment references.
Human approves each rebalance before the executor pays.
templates.builtin.solanaWorkstation.name: Solana agent workstation
templates.builtin.solanaWorkstation.desc: Orchestrator, analyst, and capped executor with Jupiter quotes and Agent Rails payments.
templates.builtin.solanaWorkstation.summ: Rails governs spend; Jupiter MCP routes swaps across Raydium, Orca, and more.
templates.builtin.solanaWorkstation.howI:
The orchestrator reads policy headroom and coordinates tasks. The analyst pulls Jupiter quotes.

The executor pays only allowlisted desks and vendors through execute_payment.

Swaps sign from the desk wallet after the treasury funds it.
templates.builtin.solanaWorkstation.setu:
pnpm agent-rails init for devnet with USDC/SOL limits.
Allowlist swap-desk and vendor wallets.
Apply this template, then create sessions per role.
Export runner config with agent-rails-integrations mcp jupiter.
Run guardian-watch before unattended executor runs.
